policy.purpose: Keep unresolved official-ruling edges out of newly sampled training decks without changing the deterministic engine's provisional semantics.
policy.scope: Initial deck sampling only. Excluded cards remain in the immutable resolver so historical replays and explicit audit fixtures can still load them.
policy.reentry_requirement: Remove an exclusion only after a direct official ruling or a versioned, reproducible client result closes every linked ruling_id.

exclusions.reason: Its turn-end emblem can set both attack and health after an older until-end-of-turn stat modifier. No direct official Q&A was found for whether that older modifier should affect the newly set value when it expires.

reachability.conclusion: The interaction is reachable through cross-class copying while 10233310 is admitted to either player's sampled deck. Excluding 10233310 from both sampled pools removes the only current full-pool SET_STATS source whose target, timing, and modified dimension can overlap an older temporary stat modifier.

exclusions.engine_semantics: The current provisional SET_STATS behavior remains explicit and testable; this policy does not claim it is the official ruling.
